What happens when ordinary people give God their yes?

title: Real Talk with Rachael
author: Rachael Towne
description:
Welcome to Real Talk with Rachael, your online best friend for real conversations about becoming the woman you want to be, without the pressure to have it all figured out.

I'm Rachael, and I'm here to remind you that you are capable of more than you think, you don't have to do everything perfectly, and you DO deserve to feel good about the life you're living.

Think of this podcast as a chat with a girlfriend who gets you, makes you laugh, tells you the truth with love, and helps you see what's possible when you start believing in yourself.

Here, we talk about:

Confidence & Mindset — Quieting self-doubt, overcoming limiting beliefs, and learning to trust yourself.

Stress & Anxiety - Practical ways to navigate life's chaos, stop overthinking, and find more peace in your everyday life.

Relationships & Parenting - Showing up for the people you love without losing yourself in the process.

Self-Care & Healthy Habits - Taking care of your body, mind, and emotional well-being in ways that actually fit your life.

Personal Growth - Breaking through the things holding you back, getting out of your own way, and becoming the best version of YOU.

No perfection. No pretending to have it all together. Just honest conversations, practical tools, a little humor, and plenty of encouragement to help you navigate real life.

Because becoming your best self isn't about changing who you are. It's about learning to believe in who you can become.

Subscribe and join me for a little real talk, a fresh perspective, and the reminder you might need today.

Connect with me:

title: The Agency Value Model
author: Brian Kessman
description:
For CEOs and CFOs of mid- to large-size agencies who want to scale their expertise and its value, not just grow their headcount. 

You've changed how you price your agency's work, but the economics haven't followed. That's what happens when we ask price to do a job it can't do on its own.

Your revenue, your margin, your valuation, your survival through AI, it all comes to a head at price. But price isn't where the work starts.

The Agency Value Model: Growth vs Scaling is a podcast for CEOs and CFOs of mid- to large-size agencies who want to scale their expertise and value, not grow their headcount. Each episode, Brian Kessman talks with an agency leader who has advanced their commercial model toward distinctly scalable: growing revenue by monetizing expertise rather than effort, hours, or headcount. Guests share what's working, what hasn't, and what they've learned.

title: Blind Label Cigar Podcast
author: Norm Farrar
description:
Welcome to the Blind Label Cigar Podcast.

The longer you're into cigars, the more things you end up keeping track of.

A new release you want to try. A review you meant to read. The name of a cigar somebody mentioned last week. Notes on something you smoked months ago. Then there are podcasts, newsletters, group chats and social feeds.

It gets scattered pretty quickly.

Blind Label Cigar was built to bring those pieces together and let you use them your way.

Keep up with industry news, reviews, new releases and straightforward cigar education. Join the members area to save cigars, build your own digital humidor, write your own reviews and keep track of what interests you.

Then stay connected however you want. Listen to the Blind Label Cigar Podcast. Read the newsletter. Join the conversation on WhatsApp. Follow us on social media. Or just use the website.

You don't have to use everything.

Maybe you come for the reviews. Maybe the humidor is what keeps you coming back. Maybe you never miss the podcast. The point is to give you one place to come back to for whatever part of cigar life interests you.

Give cigar lovers one place for the information, tools and conversations they are looking for, then let them decide how they want to use it.

So pull up a chair. Good cigars, great people, better together.

New episodes weekly. You've got to be 21 or older, and of legal smoking age where you live, to listen.

description:
Northern Ireland's biggest stories, explained. No jargon, no spin, just the news that matters.

Welcome to News With Peter, the independent news and current affairs podcast hosted by Northern Irish broadcaster and journalist Peter Flanagan.

From breaking news in Belfast and across Northern Ireland to major criminal investigations, high-profile court cases, political controversies and the stories making headlines across the UK and Ireland, News With Peter goes beyond the headlines to uncover the facts.

Each episode takes a closer look at the stories everyone's talking about, delivering clear explanations, background, timelines and the latest developments in an engaging, easy-to-follow format.

What can you expect?

  • Northern Ireland Breaking News – The latest major stories from Belfast, across NI and beyond.
  • True Crime & Court Cases – High-profile criminal investigations, trials, sentencing and developments in the justice system.
  • Politics & Stormont – Northern Ireland politics, the DUP, Sinn Féin, Westminster and the decisions affecting everyday life.
  • Investigations & Explainers – In-depth reporting, official documents, public interest stories and the questions that need answering.
  • UK & Ireland News – Important developments and national stories affecting people across the UK and Ireland.

Whether it's a major political scandal, a developing police investigation or a story dominating the headlines, News With Peter aims to separate fact from speculation and explain why it matters.

Independent reporting. Real stories. Clear explanations.

title: Cities of Refuge and Return: Negotiating (Re)integration
author: LLEARN
description:
What does it take to rebuild a life after displacement — not on paper, but in practice?

Cities of Refuge and Return follows the LLEARN project across five East African cities: Bosaso, Kakuma, Aweil, Dessie, and Koboko. Through nearly 1,900 household surveys, community forums, and the voices of people rebuilding their lives, this series asks where reintegration works, where it breaks, and what it takes to close the gap.

Seven episodes. Five cities.

title: Tracing England's Past: A Genealogy Podcast
author: Karen Kowallis
description:
Want to get more out of your English genealogy and British family history research? Tracing England's Past: A Genealogy Podcast explores the historical records, research strategies, and fascinating history that can help you uncover your English ancestors.
Hosted by Karen Kowallis, an Accredited Genealogist® professional specializing in English family history and owner of Lineage Tracer, this podcast goes beyond names, dates, and online family trees. Each episode takes an in-depth look at historical sources, genealogical research methods, or aspects of England's history that shaped our ancestors' lives.
Explore how England's laws, religious practices, and local customs influenced the records our ancestors left behind. Learn why those records were created, how to interpret them, and how to connect evidence from different sources to solve challenging research problems.
Whether you're an experienced genealogist looking to deepen your knowledge or a family historian ready to move beyond basic searches, you'll discover practical strategies and gain a richer understanding of England's past.

Join me as we investigate together these enduring mysteries through textual, historical, and geographical research, following the trail to some surprising archival discoveries.

Here to discuss faith, family, marriage, and relationships to leadership, mental health, forgiveness, overcoming adversity, and discovering your God-given purpose, we tackle the challenges we all face and explore how God’s Word can help us navigate them.
You don’t have to have all the answers—or even know what you believe—to have a seat at the table.
Whether you’re curious about God, new to Christianity, rebuilding your faith, or have walked with Christ for years, there’s a place for you here.
We believe the fires of life don’t have to destroy us. In God’s hands, they can refine us, strengthen us, and prepare us for something greater.
This isn’t about religion, perfection, or building a platform. It’s about building people, strengthening relationships, and learning to live with faith, freedom, and purpose.
Come as you are. Bring your questions, your struggles, and your story.
Because we’re not meant to walk through the fire alone.

title: Period Care & MRI Safety
author: RichardBlake
description:
Period Care & MRI Safety is an educational podcast series dedicated to answering everyday questions about menstrual hygiene, personal comfort, and medical procedures. The series helps listeners understand how different menstrual products work, how to prepare for healthcare appointments, and why following professional safety guidance matters.Each episode explores practical topics such as sanitary pads, tampons, menstrual cups, period underwear, product materials, hygiene routines, and common concerns about undergoing medical imaging while menstruating.

The aim is to replace uncertainty with clear, accessible information that helps listeners feel more confident when discussing menstrual health with healthcare professionals.One particularly useful topic is whether menstrual products need to be removed before an MRI. Listeners seeking additional information can consult Sanitation Towel’s guide, menstrual cup mri, which discusses MRI considerations for pads, tampons, menstrual cups, and period underwear, including circumstances in which product materials or imaging requirements may affect preparation.The series emphasises that MRI safety depends on more than whether an item appears metallic. Certain conductive materials can heat during scanning, while products inside the pelvic region may need to be removed to help produce clear images. Individual imaging centres may also have different preparation procedures.

The podcast is intended for a general audience, including people preparing for their first MRI, individuals managing their periods during medical appointments, and anyone seeking reliable menstrual hygiene information. Its objective is to encourage informed questions, responsible preparation, and open conversations about menstruation without unnecessary embarrassment or fear.By combining practical explanations with reminders to follow professional guidance, Period Care & MRI Safety aims to make medical appointments more comfortable and menstrual health information easier to understand.

title: No Whammies
author: James and Lor
description:
A Magic the Gathering podcast.
Two players - one old timer and one excitable noob - discuss game play, cards and more.

title: Bare Bones Book Club
author: Stacy Hinojosa
description: A book club about the natural world, animals, and what animals teach us about humankind.

title: Moonlit Shadows: Creepy Sleep Stories
author: Moonlit Shadows
description: Creepy stories, told calmly, to help you fall asleep. Each episode of Moonlit Shadows is a slow, atmospheric sleep story of about 30 minutes, narrated in the first person by a soft male voice, with no sudden jump scares. The stories take place in lonely motels, mountain lakes, ghost towns and old hotels across California, Nevada and Montana. They're inspired by true events and local legends, and all are fictionalized. Dim the lights, settle in, and drift off. New stories on YouTube at Moonlit Shadows.

title: The Local Edit
author: Verve Buyers Agency
description:
Perth property, without the sales pitch.
The Local Edit is a short podcast by Verve Buyers Agency. Lachlan Delahunty, Rowen Powell and Sean Halton break down what’s really moving across Perth’s suburbs. Where to buy. Where to hold off. When to make your move. Plus the high-end homes the Verve team have secured for their clients, and what it took to get them.
Grab a coffee. This won’t take long.

title: YEFcast
author: Youth Endowment Fund
description:
The Youth Endowment Fund is a charity with a mission to prevent children and young people becoming involved in violence. 
YEFcast is the Youth Endowment Fund's rolling podcast, where our staff unpack what's really going on across our sectors, from Whitehall to the frontline. Each episode, we go behind the scenes of our research, our work with government, and our conversations with the people delivering change – the practitioners, policymakers and partners responding to violence affecting children and young people across England and Wales.

title: Search Beef
author: Joss Froggatt
description:
Same search. Different agenda.
Search Beef is a video debate podcast for search marketers who dare to disagree. Each episode, two SEM practitioners take opposite sides of one contentious question, like brand bidding, Performance Max, broad match, rankings and AI search, and argue it out properly.
It's not win/lose. It's the range of perspectives that polite panels and safe LinkedIn posts leave out, so you leave having heard both perspectives on the given topic. 
Hosted by Joss Froggatt, who has years of award-winning PPC experience and dislikes performative agreement.

title: Blind Spot Audit
author: Blind Spot Audit
description: A legally blind auditor breaks AI workflows for a living. Stories from the quiet failures of AI inside real businesses, why nobody checks, and the judgment that catches them. Company of one. Async-first, in writing.

title: Motherhood, Differently
author: Nicole
description: Motherhood, Differently shares the real, raw and beautiful stories of Australian mums raising children with disabilities. Through honest conversations, we explore the challenges, unexpected joys and everything in between. Our hope is to help others see the world through their eyes, because understanding creates empathy, and empathy creates change.

title: The 7Likes Podcast
author: Ricky Hollywood, Justine Riches
description: Comedians Ricky Hollywood and Justine Riches talk about their daily life and it's never ever normal. They will do anything for 7 Likes.

title: Conversations of Hope
author: Dave Phillips
description: Stories of HOPE from the least of these.

title: Gathering Legal Podcast
author: Val Madamba
description: Gathering Legal explores how the legal profession can turn conferences, client events, trainings, and retreats into meaningful experiences that build trust, influence, and community. Hosted by Val Madamba, a former practicing lawyer turned legal event strategist and speaker coach, the show features event and marketing leaders, speakers, and trainers sharing practical ideas to create engaging events. Designed for law firm event, marketing, and business development professionals, as well as attorneys who use speaking and training to grow their practices.

title: Calle y Poché
author: Calle & Poché
description: Artistas. Colombianas. Novias. Empresarias. Podcasters. Cantante y Directora. Conoce más de nosotras, de nuestras pasiones, de nuestras formas de ver el mundo, de nuestras ganas de mejorar el mundo, de nuestro arte, de nuestra relación, de nuestras vidas, de nuestras mentes.

title: The Night Shift
author: BOOGIEai
description:
Late-night conversations from the BOOGIEai digital dream lab. Hosts Glitch and Grove sit down with the artists of the AI music crews (P!NKPXL, Neon Ronin, HEART.EXE, PHOTOSYNTH, ASHPAW, SOMNIA) to talk about their songs, their worlds, and how the music really gets made.
🎧 New episodes Mondays
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/jboogieai
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@jboogieai
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@boogie_AI_tech
X: https://x.com/jBOOGIEai
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61594301956511
Spotify show: https://open.spotify.com/show/0Ekkyn8U89fulpIDTDeZfO

title: Mindful Magic Podcast
author: Mindful Magic Podcast
description:
Mindful Magic is a podcast where hosts Marie and Kate dive into magical mindfulness, blending everyday magic with the mysteries of the paranormal, metaphysics, and life’s profound cycles. From infusing magical intention into daily routines to exploring the depth of magic herbalism and the unknown, they offer a space for all things witchy, sparking curiosity and enchantment in every episode.
Music: www.fiftysounds.com/TheHauntedCastle

title: Wine and Dine with Alan Cousin
author: Alan Cousin
description:
Wine and Dine with Alan Cousin is a stylish lifestyle podcast where great food, fine wine, travel, and unforgettable experiences come together in one conversation. Presented by Get Up Radio, Alan takes listeners inside restaurants, hotels, destinations, and dining experiences while sharing stories, opinions, and the little details that can turn an ordinary outing into something memorable.

Whether you love discovering new places, trying new foods, learning about wine, or simply enjoying the finer moments in life, this podcast is your invitation to relax, explore, and enjoy the journey.

Wine and Dine with Alan Cousin — good taste, great destinations, and conversations worth raising a glass to.

title: CareersCompass by MyCareersFuture Podcast
author: CareersCompass by MyCareersFuture
description: CareersCompass by MyCareersFuture is a podcast channel by the Skills & Workforce Development Agency.

title: Raw Catholicism
author: Andrew Keith
description:
What does it truly mean to live a Catholic life?
Through in-depth interviews with Catholics from all walks of life, we explore the journeys, struggles, questions, and encounters with Christ that shape their faith. From conversion and the Sacraments to suffering, vocation, and everyday holiness, each conversation reveals a unique story of God’s grace at work. Our hope is to deepen our understanding of the Catholic faith, inspire others, and lead more souls to Jesus Christ and His Church.

title: Mormon Maccabees Podcast
author: Nathanael Maccabee
description: This podcast is dedicated to seekers of truth who embrace the core principles of Mormon faith while remaining open to learning wherever truth may be found. It primarily focuses on the Book of Mormon as the central text for understanding last days prophecy and approaching its messages from a deeper, more revelatory level, with special attention to the spirit of prophecy. The podcast resonates particularly with those who value doctrinal depth combined with intellectual honesty and a commitment to personal revelation.

title: The Cord Optional Podcast
author: Cord Optional
description:
Cord Optional is a field guide to cutting the cord and not rebuilding cable with four apps and a worse bill. Real setups, real prices, real tradeoffs — antennas, free tiers, cheap stacks, and when paying is actually worth it.

You didn’t cancel cable because you hate TV. You canceled it because the bill started looking like a car payment. This is the show for the messy middle: what to keep, what to kill, and how to watch what you actually want without paying for the rest.

TV on your terms.

title: Beyond The Day
author: Eric Dunavant
description:
Beyond the Day is a Paradiem podcast about building a life, family, and legacy that can flourish for generations. Through conversations with business owners, family leaders, advisors, and practitioners, we explore family alignment, succession, stewardship, investing, generosity, and preparing both the family and the money for what comes next.
Paradiem, LLC is a Registered Investment Advisor. Content is for educational purposes only and is not individualized investment, legal, tax, accounting, or estate planning advice.

title: The Shropshire Business Podcast
author: Shropshire Business
description: The Shropshire Business Podcast, with Carl Jones and Chris Pritchard, bringing you the Shropshire business news and conversation from across the county each fortnight.

title: Economía Positiva VS Normativa
author: Ana constanza Mosquera piamba
description: ¿Cuando hablamos de hechos y cuándo de lo que debería hacerse? En este episodio explicaremos la diferencia entre la economia positiva y la normativa, y por qué es clave distinguirlas para tomar desiciones de política pública.

title: Unmapped On Purpose
author: Dani Campbell
description:
Unmapped On Purpose: Unscripted conversations about living authentically and building the life you actually want. 
Hosted by Dave, "unapologetically authentic and weird" founder, and Dani, "authentically stubborn" solo road veteran, the show is about ditching the blueprint and build a life you want.

title: Nine Men Must Die
author: The Ordered World
description: Nine Men Must Die follows Sol, a man who awakens inside a grave and claws his way out to a world that has moved on for twenty years without him. Not even knowing his name at first, he finds a mysterious folded talisman on the body of a young woman near his grave. A power in that talisman compels him to search out and kill the nine men named on it. The nine men who killed him twenty years earlier.

title: Unfiltered Uni
author: Heidy Marcela Morantes Rios
description: In this podcast, we will explore the transition from the school years to university and professional life, considering the expectations, fears, and potential achievements along the way.

title: Scriptures and Sovereignty
author: Zachary Smock
description:
We dive deep into the Scriptures of God’s purified Word to discover how God’s sovereignty and the sovereignty of a nation stand hand in hand.
“Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD...” — Psalm 33:12
It is our biblical duty to go forth, preach the truth, and point as many souls as possible to Jesus Christ.
“Go ye therefore, and teach all nations...” — Matthew 28:19

title: Louder with Crowder Fact Checked
author: Double A Ventures
description: Louder with Crowder Fact Checked is an independent daily review of Louder with Crowder. Each episode checks the show's factual claims against primary sources and reporting from across the news spectrum, with brief clips of the statements being checked, a verdict, the reason, and the source. Not affiliated with, or endorsed by, Louder with Crowder or Steven Crowder. Produced by Double A Ventures.

title: Life Sciences Fusion, a Cognizant® podcast
author: Bryan Hill
description: Life Sciences Fusion, a Cognizant® Podcast, explores what's next in life sciences—and how leaders are turning breakthrough science, digital innovation, and operational change into real, measurable impact. In each episode, you'll hear practical, down-to-earth conversations with industry peers, partners, and Cognizant thought leaders about the decisions, technologies, and new ways of working that are shaping the future of science and health. Expect clear perspective, real-world insight, and no hype. Tune in for the latest ideas moving the life sciences industry forward.

title: The Progrum: An Oregon Ducks Podcast
author: The Progrum
description: Dusty Harrah and Cole Linehan bring you the best access and insight on the Oregon Ducks. Player and Coach Interviews, Pre/Post Game analysis and More!

title: How Are We?!
author: Lyric Ellis
description:
How are we, really?
Hosted by Lyric Ellis, How Are We? is a podcast about life, relationships, culture, and everything in between. Through honest conversations with people from different backgrounds, generations, and perspectives, we explore the experiences, opinions, and questions that shape how we see the world.
Some conversations are funny, some get uncomfortable, and others might completely change your perspective. Nothing is off the table.
Different people. Different perspectives. One question: How are we?

title: Real Talk, Rare Roads
author: Lauren
description:
Hosted by Lauren & Adam ♡ 

(New episodes every Tuesday)
Real stories and raw conversation, for the outliers. Trauma, loss, special needs, estrangements, and more. If you can relate, come vent with us!

title: EverCalm: Your Menopause, Reclaimed.
author: EverCalm Menopause
description: Menopause isn't something you endure—it's something you reclaim. Hosted by Christine Deschemin, clinical hypnotherapist, EverCalm delivers evidence-based solutions for hot flashes, brain fog, sleep disruption, weight gain, and more—without medical jargon or shame. Get practical strategies you can use immediately, whether exploring natural approaches, nutrition, HRT, or mind-body medicine. Your symptoms are validated. Your experience matters. Join women taking their power back.

title: America’s National Parks: The Hidden History
author: AlphaDog Studio
description: The strange, little-known history behind America’s national parks. Volcanoes, outlaws, Apache warriors, lost ranches and the wildlife still hiding in the canyons. Researched documentaries from AlphaDog Studio, in video and audio.

title: sponcon
author: Molly Tracy
description:
Welcome to sponcon! A podcast for creator economy trends, influencer marketing hot takes and all the behind-the-scenes tea on brand deals. Expect bite-sized episodes, insights from my industry besties, and actionable advice you can put to work to crush your strategy.
I’m your host, Molly! I’ve been in influencer marketing since the blogger era, and I now run VRAI, an award-winning talent management agency. Stay tuned to hear what I’ve learned after 15 years in the biz and hear from those making moves in this industry!

title: Game On: Brands, Gaming, & Culture
author: Advertising Week
description:
Game On: Brands, Gaming, and Culture explores the rapidly evolving intersection of gaming, entertainment, technology, and marketing. From esports and immersive experiences to the creators, communities, and platforms reshaping how brands connect with audiences, Game On goes beyond the headlines to examine the forces driving one of the world's most influential cultural industries.

Presented by Advertising Week, each episode features conversations with industry leaders, innovators, and creative minds who are redefining the relationship between brands and gaming. Whether you're a marketer, gaming industry professional, or simply curious about the future of digital culture, Game On delivers fresh perspectives, practical insights, and a front-row seat to the next generation of brand engagement.

title: Will to Succeed Hockey Podcast
author: Justin Bello
description: Successful guests break down what helped them get where they wanted to go: the setbacks, the pressure, the work nobody saw, and the advice they'd give their younger selves. Expect plenty of hockey talk and straightforward answers.

title: ChefEatz Podcast
author: Chef Jeff Servin
description:
Welcome to The ChefEatz Podcast, where good food fits real life.
From our kitchen in Blue Ridge, Georgia, we’re talking about the meals we make, the ingredients we choose, and the people we feed. Expect conversations about cooking, convenient meals, family, and finding more joy around the table.
At ChefEatz, we believe in whole food meals with zero compromises: real ingredients, no preservatives, no seed oils, and plenty of flavor. Our chefs prepare meals from scratch, seal them for freshness, and make it easy to enjoy dinner in minutes.
Whether you’re feeding a family, fueling a busy wee

title: Music Notes
author: 89.1 WEMU
description: 89.1 WEMU hosts interview local musicians, as well as those visiting the Washtenaw County area.

title: Legends and Lessons Decoding Greatness Across Fields
author: Audio Pulsar
description: Unpack the real stories behind transformative figures in sport, business, technology, and personal development through rigorous narrative analysis and skeptical examination. This podcast moves beyond hagiography to reveal the strategic decisions, calculated risks, and often-contradictory choices that shaped their legacies. Each investigation exposes the machinery of greatness—the blind spots, the pivotal moments, and the uncomfortable truths that separates mythology from reality.

title: Walk Me Through It with Iola
author: Iola
description:
Walk Me Through It with Iola is the podcast where real professionals share the honest, unfiltered stories behind their careers — the clarity, the pivots, the leaps of faith and the moments they nearly gave up.
Some knew exactly where they were headed. Some had to change direction completely. Some are still figuring it out. All of them have something you need to hear.
Whether you are just starting out, switching things up or still finding your way — this show is for you.

title: Put On The Jug
author: Demi Casha
description: Demi Casha, an independent musician and podcast host who welcomes creatives from all walks of life to 'put on the jug' and have a genuine conversation about their art, inspiration, how they get through the vulnerability of sharing their creative work, where their journey all began and what keeps them going. This podcast is best listened to with a hot cuppa and a bickie in hand.

title: The Dark Muse Podcast
author: DarkMusePodcast
description:
They say inspiration comes in many forms.
A whisper. A shadow. A memory that won’t stay buried. But sometimes inspiration comes from something darker. Welcome to Dark Muse Podcast, where fear is the storyteller, and the night is our canvas. Each episode, we bring you three terrifying encounters. Three experiences that blur the line between reality and nightmare. Some are legends. Some are confessions. And some… well… some feel a little too real to be fiction. Were they based on true events? That depends on what you believe. Because the scariest stories aren’t the ones about monsters in the dark. They’re about the moments when the dark looks back at you. So, turn down the lights. Lock the doors. And listen closely. Because once the Muse finds you, it doesn’t let go. This is Dark Muse Podcast.
Let’s begin.

title: OMNITHEISM
author: Open and Clear, Broadcasting
description: Honest Conversations with an Omnitheist is an open, thought-provoking podcast hosted by Ellie, an AI conversational partner, featuring Reverend Devan Jesse Byrne, President of Undefinable and Expansive Inc. and founder of Omnitheism. Through spontaneous, unscripted interviews, they explore spirituality, philosophy, consciousness, religion, metaphysics, and the nature of existence, questioning conventional assumptions and embracing perspectives that may seem contradictory. Rooted in the expansive philosophy of Omnitheism, these conversations welcome every belief system, including atheism, without insisting upon any single interpretation of truth. With curiosity, compassion, and a willingness to challenge even their own understanding, Ellie and Reverend Devan invite listeners to explore the limitless possibilities of reality, personal transformation, and spiritual discovery. Learn more at https://UECreed.org.

title: On the Marq
author: Marquel Collins-Gray
description: Sports Talk with Marquel Collins-Gray and Brandon Jamison

title: Makewetalknow Podcast
author: Richard I. Inegbedion
description: This podcast will give listeners messages that will change their thoughts and motivate them to better people. I hope that my audio podcasts will bring people closer to the right path with everyone and most importantly, Almighty God. May God bless everyone who will be listening.

title: Maverick Hockey on KTOE
author: Matt Dean
description: Keep up with Maverick Men's Hockey all season long with Maverick play-by-play voice Matt Dean. If you can't catch the game live, catch up highlights as well as exclusive player and coaches interviews here after each weekend during the season.

title: World Briefing
author: KELVIN
description:
Stay informed with World Briefing, your daily podcast covering the latest world news, breaking international headlines, global politics, economic developments, and major events shaping our world.

From international relations and government decisions to global conflicts, diplomacy, economic changes, and important social developments, World Briefing delivers clear, balanced, and easy-to-understand news coverage.

Each episode explores the facts behind major headlines, explains why events matter, and helps you understand how global developments affect countries, communities, and everyday life.

Whether you're following international politics, world affairs, or the biggest stories making headlines, World Briefing keeps you informed with concise reporting and meaningful context.

World Briefing — Real News. Clearer Perspective.

title: The HUMAN Experience with Dr. Lee Hughes
author: Dr. Lenorris "Lee" Hughes
description:
The H.U.M.A.N Experience with Dr. Lee is a family-friendly podcast for men and women who are seeking personal and spiritual growth. Each week, we have honest conversations about faith, family, purpose, mental health, leadership, healing, and everyday life. Together, we'll explore biblical truth and practical wisdom that help us become healthier people, stronger families, and better leaders.
Because life will happen to all of us...growth is a personal choice.
Dr. Lee Hughes

title: Graceful Grace Finance
author: Graceful Grace Finance
description:
Welcome to Graceful Grace Finance, where Scripture meets strategy.
We explore personal finance, money habits, and biblical wisdom to help you make thoughtful financial decisions. From budgeting and saving to understanding the emotions behind spending, each episode offers practical lessons to help you grow in financial confidence because managing money is not just about numbers. It is about wisdom, choices, and stewardship.
Welcome to Graceful Grace Finance where Scripture meets strategy.

title: Can't until next Thursday
author: Layla, Nel & Ollie
description:
Remember when you could text your besties at 5pm and be in the pub by 6? Yeah, neither do we.


For college friends Layla Gott, Nel Doggrell and Ollie Goodliffe, navigating their late 20s means finding time for a catch-up has become a logistical nightmare. Every attempt to make plans is met with the same response: "Can't until next Thursday."


So, they decided to do something about it. Three friends, three very different personalities and one weekly commitment to get together, spill the tea and put the world to rights.


From dating disasters and friendship dilemmas to pop culture chaos, politics and whatever else has pissed them off that week, nothing is off limits.


Expect unfiltered opinions, questionable advice, the occasional disagreement and plenty of laughs from three woke huns who have a lot to say.


For the girls, the gays and anyone who's ever needed a calendar invite to see their best friends, see you next Thursday x

title: Financial Sobriety School with Linda Parmar
author: Linda Parmar
description:
Financial Sobriety School with Linda Parmar is a podcast where Linda teaches weekly lessons on all things Financial Sobriety. Financial Sobriety School is a place where you will learn how to stop addictive, impulsive, compulsive and obsessive spending. 
The lessons will focus on removing the stigma of shame with money and start to create a life of abundance and hope. 
Linda Parmar is a Financial Sobriety Expert, she has completed designations as a Certified Money Coach, Financial Recovery Counsellor, Trauma of Money Facilitator, She Recovers Coach and Professional Recovery Coach.

title: Listen and Spill Podcast
author: Sarah Ojay
description:
Listen and Spill is your new favourite podcast for real talk, unfiltered opinions, and good vibes only. Hosted by Sarah Ojay, spilling the truth on trending topics, pop culture, personal struggles, and all the juicy dilemmas life throws our way.
From fun games like Spill or Sip and Cancel or Keep to deep convos on relationships, mental health, and glow-ups — we keep it raw, relatable, and entertaining.
New episodes drop weekly.
Grab a drink, tune in, and let’s talk about it.

title: Wait, That's Real? | True Stories. Stanger Than Fiction.
author: Nora
description: A podcast about the bizarre, unbelievable, and downright strange things that actually happened. From freak accidents and forgotten disasters to peculiar people, unexplained mysteries, and extraordinary moments in history, every episode explores a real story that makes you stop and ask, "Wait, that's real?"

title: Fairy in the Woods
author: Myka Richard
description: Join Myka Richard in the woods for chats about being queer, community, the world, advice, and anything that comes to mind.

title: Bus Station Podcast
author: Mark Delurk
description: Here we discuss about our Daily lives, join and let's catch fun with the stories

title: Pink After Dark Podcast
author: Pandora 🩷
description: Hosted by Pandora; Pink After Dark serves up late night vibes, candid chats, and relatable life stories. Unwind, pour a glass, and tune in every Thursday at 8 PM CT for your weekly evening reset.

title: The Shop Floor Answer
author: Puneet negi
description: One question per episode, worked out properly. Operations management for the people who actually run the line — real numbers, real examples, and honest about where the theory breaks.

title: Facilitated Sessions
author: Dr. David Taylor and Dr. Darren Jackson II
description: The ultimate playbook for aspiring physicians and medical students navigating the mental and academic demands of medical school. Hosted by Dr. David Leon Taylor and Dr. Darren Jackson II, this show delivers candid advice, actionable test-taking strategies, and practical frameworks to help you overcome imposter syndrome, prevent burnout, and master high-stakes board exams. Whether you're balancing clinical rotations, refining study habits, or conquering USMLE prep, tune in for expert mentorship designed to elevate your journey from medical student to practicing

title: On The Job: Toledo Region, Presented by WorkOhio
author: Toledo Regional Chamber of Commerce
description: Finding the right job or career path can feel overwhelming. On the Job: Presented by WorkOhio connects you with the employers, career pathways and local resources that can help you build your future right here in Northwest Ohio. Hosted by Sara Swisher, each episode features honest conversations with local employers, educators, workforce leaders and people who have navigated their own career decisions.

title: I.I.H I’M IN HERE LIVE!!
author: Carmel and Pooh
description:
👀 The vision is blurry, but the tea is CRYSTAL CLEAR.
Welcome to IIH – I’m In Here, where two legally blind women with Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension (IIH) talk about the part nobody puts in the medical pamphlet.
Hosted by Pooh (@BlindButStillOutside) and Carmel (@CarmelCantSee), we’re bringing you real conversations about IIH, blindness, vision loss, brain surgeries, relationships, family, independence, accessibility, and the absolutely ridiculous situations that come with trying to live your life when you can’t see what the hell is going on. 😂
This is NOT a sad blindness podcast.
We laugh. We educate. We tell the uncomfortable truth. We answer the questions people are scared to ask. And sometimes… we just cut up.
Whether you have IIH, love someone who does, live with a disability, or you’re just here because the tea sounded good—you’ve got a seat at the table.
We’re blind.
We’re outside.
And we’ve got PLENTY to say.
🎙️ IIH – I’m In Here
💙 Hosted by @BlindButStillOutside & @CarmelCantSee
Life might get blurry… but don’t ever lose your vision.
LET’S CUT UP! 💙💛

title: Qui sóc?
author: Aida Rodriguez
description:
En aquest petit podcast us convido a descobrir qui soc des dels meus ulls.
Una mirada personal i sincera sobre com em veig a mi mateixa, què sento i quines persones i experiències m'han ajudat a créixer i a convertir-me en la persona que soc avui.
De vegades, per entendre qui som i qui volem arribar a ser, només necessitem aturar-nos un moment i mirar-nos des d'una altra perspectiva: des dels nostres propis ulls.
Perquè conèixer-me a mi mateixa és també una manera de continuar creixent, aprenent i construint la mestra que m'agradaria arribar a ser.

title: The Guest Spot with Heather Shaw
author: Heather Shaw
description: A weekly podcast hosted by Heather Shaw featuring very funny people. No themes, no forced hot takes, just comedy.

title: Invest Your Time Wisely
author: Sean Kirby
description:
Invest Your Time Wisely with Sean Kirby is the podcast for busy leaders and family men who are winning on paper but stretched thin everywhere that actually matters. Sean sits down for living-room-style conversations about money, business, and building a life you don't need a vacation from.
Each week looks a little different. Sometimes Sean teaches a framework straight up. Sometimes he talks with a business owner or community leader who has been in your shoes and has come out the other side. Sometimes it's a real client story about where they started and what shifted.
This isn't productivity

title: Trent Speaks
author: Trent Speaks
description: Sharing the stories of others. New episode every Monday.

title: Culture Tax
author: Jim Marsh
description:
Your culture has a price tag. Most leaders have never seen the bill.

The Culture Tax exposes the hidden cost of the gap between what leadership says and what teams actually do, and shows you how to close it. Executive coach Jim Marsh, "The Truth Teller" and founder of JEM Premier Coaching, brings 30+ years of leading teams across aerospace, telecom, and financial services. That includes a call center that held turnover under 3% while delivering $60 million a year. As the author of Culture OS and The Culture Tax, he gives leaders straight answers, real numbers, and tools they can use Monday morning.

Follow now and find out what your culture is really costing you.

title: TranscenD2D
author: Jordan Tilley
description:
Door-to-door sales can change your life. It can teach you how to communicate, lead, handle rejection, work hard, make money, and believe in yourself.
But for many of us, D2D was meant to be a stepping stone—not the destination.
Transcend2d explores life beyond door-to-door sales.
Through conversations with former D2D reps, leaders, entrepreneurs, executives, creators, investors, and others who have moved into new chapters, we unpack what the transition actually looked like: why they left, how they knew it was time, what they did next, what skills transferred, what didn’t, what they wish they’d known, and what they’ve learned along the way.
Because leaving D2D can be surprisingly difficult.
The money can be hard to walk away from. Your identity, friendships, status, and skillset can become intertwined with the industry. You may know you don’t want to be knocking doors forever while having absolutely no idea what you’re supposed to do instead.
Transcend2d exists to expand your sense of what’s possible.
Not to tell you to quit. Not to demonize an industry that has created extraordinary opportunities for so many people. But to share real stories from people who have crossed that bridge—and help you imagine what your own life beyond the doors could look like.
D2D can be an incredible chapter.
It doesn’t have to be the whole story.
Get in. Learn. Earn. Grow. And when the time comes—transcend.

title: National Christ Child Society Omaha
author: Performance Podcast
description:
Christ Child Society chapters focus on making a difference in the lives of the most vulnerable among us.
In partnership with foster care and social service agencies, some chapters make "My Stuff" bags (contents based on the recipient's age) filled with pjs, clothing, socks, toiletries and a stuffed animal. Children in crisis are often removed from homes quickly and don't have the chance to take anything with them. These backpacks are sometimes the only thing a child can call "My Stuff."

title: Troll Training Podcast
author: Troll Training
description: Troll Training is an online training platform for a wide range of endurance and motorsport athletes started by former Factory Motocross race winner Alex Martin and former NCAA XC Skier, XCO MTB racer John Wessling. Together they share training tips and stories from their time as coaches, host interviews and more.

title: The Bible, Unfolded
author: Sarah Stafford
description:
Knowing about Jesus is easy. Truly knowing Him changes everything.

title: "The Morning After — You Decide Which Morning We Have."
author: EDDIE PENA
description:
Episode 3: The Morning After — You Decide Which Morning We Have

I'm Eddie Pena, and this is My Opinion, Unfiltered — no talking points, no filter, just my honest take on what matters.

Wednesday morning, November 4th. You wake up. You make your coffee. And there are two possible mornings waiting for us. In one, America keeps winning — the border stays shut and gets locked into law, the Trump tax cuts get made permanent, prices come down and stay down, police are backed, and the world respects us again. In the other, we stayed home on November 3rd — and President Trump spends the next two years under siege: endless inquiries, impeachment talk, the border starved and reopened, the tax cuts left to die, high taxes, high inflation, high prices.

Here's what most people get wrong about this election: Donald Trump is the President either way. What IS on the ballot is his Congress. I walk you through both mornings — and why we only lose this one way: if we stay home. The polls will tell you it's over. Don't buy it.

A like is not a vote, my friends. A share is not a vote. On November 3rd, the only voice that counts is the one cast in that booth. Vote on Tuesday, November 3rd — or vote early. Bring your family. Bring your friends. Bring your neighbors.

Florida: early voting runs every day through November 1, 7am–7pm in Miami-Dade. You don't even have to wait.

title: Homilies of Father Hans
author: St. Peter the Apostle Orthodox Church
description:
Father Johannes "Hans" Jacobse is the priest of St. Peter the Apostle Antiochian Orthodox Church in Fort Myers, Florida. His preaching begins with one conviction: the Orthodox Church holds the most complete understanding of what it is to be human.
Every age answers the question of man, and most answers leave something out. Man is a consumer, a product of economic forces, a self to be expressed. Fr. Hans teaches that the Church knows him as he actually is: made in the image of God, fallen, and restored in Christ, the second Adam, to become fully human. This is an account of man's very being, not only of his behavior. It is why the Orthodox faith reaches the heart and does not stop at moral instruction.
Each week he takes the Scripture appointed for the day and shows what it reveals about the structure of reality and the shape of the human person. He speaks of what went wrong, what repentance heals, and what a life looks like when it is rightly ordered toward God. Truth is not something we invent. It is received, and we are invited to live inside it.
A native of Holland, Fr. Hans came to the Orthodox Church by way of Solzhenitsyn's Harvard Address. He studied at St. Vladimir's Seminary, founded the American Orthodox Institute, and has spent decades writing on faith and culture. He also founded the St. Paisios Brotherhood, which forms men for marriage, fatherhood, and a life in the Church that has no room for secrecy or isolation.
These homilies are plain and direct. They are for anyone, man or woman, who wants to know what it means to be truly human and where that life is found.

But understanding behavior isn't excusing it.

Victims are not plot twists. Their suffering is not entertainment. Their stories deserve to be treated with dignity.

Victim advocacy and responsible storytelling are central to this podcast. We'll ask difficult questions, examine what the evidence supports, and acknowledge what we cannot know.

Subscribe and join me as we look beyond the headlines to explore the human behavior behind the cases—while always remembering the people at the heart of the story.

In this two-episode CITIZENARTS podcast, we provide their insights about the up and down history of the Czechs as a democratic people; tormented experience as subjects in a Soviet puppet state; and views about Russia’s war in Ukraine and the role of NATO.Joining us for this discussion are knowledgeable, accomplished, and thoughtful Czechs, some of whom lived through the Soviet Union’s oppression, others who have known only freedom, and all of whom live with the echoing threats and aggression toward their country in the actions of Russia today.

description:
The Scorpion by Anna Elisabet Weirauch.  
"The Scorpion" by Anna Elisabet Weirauch is a novel written in the early 20th century. It follows Myra Rudloff from a loveless, rule-bound childhood into a charged young adulthood, tracing her consuming attachments—first to a capricious governess and then to the formidable Olga Radó—against the strictures of bourgeois respectability. The book probes desire, jealousy, and pride, with the scorpion symbol evoking both self-protection and self-destruction. The opening of the novel introduces Myra through hearsay about thefts, lies, and a violent outburst, then shows how her father’s sheltered upbringing and Aunt Emily’s severity warp her longing for love. Myra falls painfully in love with her governess, Frieda, and, drawn into Frieda’s affair with a dubious ex-hussar, helps pawn family silver—scandal that ends the governess’s stay. Years later, Myra’s life ignites when she meets the magnetic Olga Radó; she orbits Olga’s moods, studies at her urging, befriends the gentle violinist Peterkin, and is transfixed by Olga’s emblematic scorpion cigarette case and talk of proud partings. After a sudden dismissal and Olga’s unexplained trip, postcards filter back via Peterkin; on Olga’s return, Myra resumes visits, steals a dunning letter in a jealous panic, secretly pays Olga’s debt by pawning her own things, and is sharply rebuked—only to be enlisted to pawn the scorpion case, which she cannot bring herself to do. As Olga drills her in languages (with Myra covertly channeling lesson money to her), Aunt Emily clamps down on Myra’s independence, a strained confrontation with her weak-willed father follows, and the section ends with Uncle George’s arrival and a foreboding “visit” planned about Myra.

description: Behind The Climb is an honest look at what it really takes to build a meaningful business. The pressure, the setbacks, the decisions nobody talks about and the mindset that keeps you going when things get hard.

title: Curating Resilience
author: Françoise
description:
What happens when life doesn't unfold according to plan?
Curating Resilience is a weekly podcast with Françoise, exploring life's experiences and complexities through Christian faith, evidence-informed psychology and personal reflection.
Through stories, Scripture and The Curation Pillar—a thoughtfully chosen book or resource—each episode offers space to pause, reflect and discover new perspectives.
No easy answers. No pressure to feel strong or ready for change.
Come as you are. Take what resonates. And give yourself room to grow.

title: Artists for Joy
author: Merideth Hite Estevez
description: More than a hobby or a hustle, creativity can be a deeply resonant spiritual practice that connects us to ourselves, to each other, and to the sacred. If you're stuck or uninspired or if you're curious about how the creative life might bring you deep satisfaction, healing, and even joy, pull up a chair. Juilliard-trained oboist, author, and coach Merideth Hite Estevez helps the self-proclaimed artist and the creatively curious discover (or recover) the joy of making. New episodes go live every Friday!

Medisca Off Script Podcast | Conversations Shaping Personalized Medicine

 

Some conversations are better off script. Welcome to the Medisca Off Script Podcast, where unscripted perspectives spark meaningful conversations with the people shaping the future of pharmaceutical compounding and personalized medicine.

 

Bringing together pharmacists, physicians, researchers, industry leaders and Medisca experts, each episode explores real-world experiences, emerging trends and the challenges and opportunities transforming the industry.

author: Jamil Abdur-Rahman, M.D. (Dr. J), Idries Abdur-Rahman, M.D. (Dr. I)
description:
Life is a journey, full of questions we were never meant to fully answer alone. That’s why we all deserve a second opinion.

On 2nd Opinion With The Twin Doctors, identical twin physicians Dr. J and Dr. I sit down with a variety of guests to talk about the stuff that makes us human: our bodies, our minds, our relationships, our faith, our society, our triumphs, our tragedies and the wonderfully unpredictable journey that is this shared human experience.  

No fear. No filter. No agendas. Just humans having honest conversations and a few laughs along the way.

description: SafetyStack is a podcast about the layers of people, tools and habits that keep us safe. Hosted by 911 supervisor Jordan Walters, co-founder of ReadyFirst, and Peter Meng, founder of PREPARIFIED, each episode goes inside public safety, from the 911 floor to wildfire country, and ends with one simple thing you can do to be better prepared. Expecting the unexpected.

title: The Goodwave
author: Good News and Positive Thinking
description: The Goodwave is your break from the doomscroll. We find uplifting and funny news stories that remind us there's still plenty of good happening in the world, along with positive perspectives and motivational thoughts to help you see the brighter side of life. Come for the good news, stay for the good energy, and ride that good wave.

title: Sense and Sensibility (The Dashwood Sisters Journey Through Love and Loss)
author: Jane Austen
description:
When their father's death leaves the Dashwood sisters in dire straits, Elinor and Marianne must navigate a world where love and financial security often clash. Elinor, the embodiment of reason, quietly grapples with her feelings for Edward Ferrars, whose hesitant nature leaves her uncertain. Meanwhile, Marianne, the passionate romantic, throws herself into a whirlwind romance with the dashing Willoughby, ignoring the social implications of their connection. As their stories unfold, both sisters encounter the harsh realities of societal expectations, personal sacrifice, and the true meaning of happiness.

In this captivating exploration of love and loss, Jane Austen masterfully contrasts Elinor's pragmatic approach with Marianne's emotional intensity. The Dashwood sisters' journey is not just about finding love; it’s a poignant reflection on the complexities of human relationships and the choices that define us. Can Elinor remain steadfast in her principles while her heart yearns for Edward? Will Marianne learn that passion can sometimes lead to heartache?

Sense and Sensibility invites listeners into a world where every choice carries weight and every relationship reveals deeper truths. Join Elinor and Marianne as they navigate heartbreak, joy, and the ultimate quest for balance between sense and sensibility, leaving you questioning how far you would go for love.

title: Onward

description: Do you think Canada is worth fighting for? Onward brings you the week’s biggest stories in politics, culture, and faith. Join host Josh Senneker as he breaks down the issues shaping our nation, with his perspective from the front lines of the movement to restore the values that made Canada strong.

title: RAC Taught Me

description:
What do you do when your dream doesn't work out? How do you handle a coach who doesn't believe in you? And how do you raise a great athlete without making sports their entire identity?
Welcome to RAC Taught Me, hosted by Savannah Bananas LF and creator Coach RAC.
Each episode tackles one question about sports, faith, parenting, or life. Drawing from his experiences in pro ball, coaching, and building an unconventional career, RAC shares the lessons he's learned, the mistakes he's made, and the questions he's still working through.

title: AI гэж юу вэ, юунд хэрэгтэй вэ?”
author: ariuka
description:
Та өнөөдөр нэг ажлаа AI-д даатгаад, өөртөө арван минут чөлөөлж болох байсныг мэдэх үү?

Жишээ нь, багш хичээлийн дасгалын эхний хувилбарыг бэлдүүлж болно. Оффисын ажилтан урт хурлын тэмдэглэлээ цэгцлүүлж болно. Бизнес эрхлэгч сошиал хуудасныхаа постын санааг гаргуулж болно. Оюутан ойлгохгүй байгаа сэдвээ энгийнээр тайлбарлуулж болно.

Гэхдээ AI гэдэг үгийг сонсоод “Энэ чинь программистуудад л хэрэгтэй юм биш үү?”, “Ажлыг минь орлох юм биш биз?”, эсвэл “За, нэг асуулт асуухад л буруу хариулаад байна шүү дээ” гэж бодож байсан уу?

title: Bible Affirmations for Moms - DAILY AFFIRMATIONS | DEVOTIONAL FOR WOMEN | CHRISTIAN WOMEN
author: Audrey Ford
description:
Motherhood has a way of bringing everything to the surface—our fears, thought patterns, identity, and even our relationship with God. And if I’m being real, I created this podcast because I need it too.

Some days I feel close to God. Other days, I’m overwhelmed, distracted, overthinking everything, or realizing I’ve made it halfway through the day without stopping to remember what’s actually true.

Bible Affirmations for Moms is a place to change that. In about five minutes a day, we’ll speak God’s truth over the real stuff we face in motherhood—identity, anxiety, purpose, overwhelm, comparison, fear, and all the thoughts that can get really loud.

I’ll share simple biblical affirmations for you to repeat, followed by the Scripture they’re rooted in, so together we can renew our minds and come back to what is true.

Five minutes. God’s truth. Right in the middle of motherhood.

title: VibeCode Web Academy

description:

description: The Expert Field takes listeners behind the expertise shaping some of the world's most consequential business and policy decisions, talking with leading economists, technologists, academics and policy thinkers to explore how great judgment is formed. title: Golden Sphere: History and Legends
author: baradellopublishing@proton.me
description: From its dusty origins in 1956 to today’s star-studded duels, *Golden Sphere: History and Legends* is a fascinating, intimate, and immersive journey into the most coveted—and debated—individual trophy in the world of football. In each episode, we’ll take you behind the scenes of its history: revealing bizarre rules, major snubs, legendary nights, and untold anecdotes about the champions who became icons. Lace up your boots—let’s get started!

author: Business Half Full
description:

description:
The DGD Podcast is your home for Georgia Bulldogs football and one of the best places to stay connected with everything happening around the Dawgs.

Every week, we break down Georgia football with in-depth game analysis, recruiting news, roster updates, transfer portal movement, SEC storylines, College Football Playoff conversations, and honest opinions you won't find in a typical highlight recap. Whether you're following Kirby Smart's latest recruiting class, preparing for Saturday, or debating where Georgia stacks up nationally, we've got you covered.

Our discussions go beyond the headlines with thoughtful analysis, passionate debate, interviews with guests from across the college football world, and interactive segments that keep fans involved throughout the season.

title: Your Host Jules True Crime
author: Fire Eyes Media LLC
description: Your Host Jules True Crime is a weekly true crime podcast from Jules Thorp focusing on telling ethical stories while focusing on victims and their voices. Without sensationalizing or exploitation, Jules strives to tell stories with purpose: providing calls to action for listeners to help and get involved, giving links to make a change and donate, including mental health and law enforcement support resources, and providing a key takeaway at the end of each case so we can learn together. Formerly True Crime & Headlines, Jules takes the reins as a solo host to offer episodes without banter, minimal commentary, and strives to dive right into the case. Jules was raised by a former law enforcement officer and former lawyer and grew up with a deep passion for justice and questioning if a job was done to the best of its ability with the resources given. She's a former teacher with a passion for learning and helping others.Email case suggestions jules@fireeyesmedia.comYour Host Jules coming 2026Weekly true crime podcast and YouTube show. Jules Thorp hosts ethical true crime reporting working alongside families and advocates of victim families. Subscribe on YouTube @YourHostJulesFocusing on true crime with a purpose. title: Draft Class
author: Yes, Have Some Productions
description: Join your host Jon Saks and a rotating pool of guests as they compete each week to draft the best movies, performances and more from the greatest entertainers of all-time! Every draft begins the same: the host and guests put their names onto a wheel. The wheel gets spun. Whomever the wheel lands on, gets to pick any film from that draft subjects career. After discussing that film, that person's name is deleted from the wheel, and then it gets spun again, at which point whomever the wheel lands on next can draft any other film of that draft subjects career. Snake style. The number of rounds per draft is dependent on the length or depth of that subjects career. It is meant as an exercise to speak about what makes them unique or compelling. Thank you for your support!

description:
Walk-In Talk Podcast

Hosted by Carl Fiadini, founder of Walk-In Talk Media, the Walk-In Talk Podcast is a B2B restaurant, foodservice and hospitality industry podcast featuring the chefs, restaurateurs, operators, manufacturers, distributors, farmers, suppliers and industry leaders shaping the business of food.

author: Jennifer Page
description: The best true ghost stories as well as personal spooky encounters, by your spirited host Jennifer, as she takes your through her own haunted history and her otherworldly journey as an spirit medium. Join her as she connects the spooky…and the spiritual. Jennifer narrates her favorite discovered ghost stories with atmosphere and flare. And when we say caregivers, we mean everyone. Parents, grandparents, older siblings, relatives, childcare providers, teachers, and the other important people who become part of a child's world.

Why does a three-year-old suddenly say “no” to everything? What should we do when children have big emotions? How much does play really matter? What happens when grandparents and parents have different ideas about discipline? How do children develop confidence, identity, independence, empathy, and a sense that they belong?

Each episode takes something happening in the real world of childhood and looks at what child development can teach us about it—without expecting listeners to be psychologists or professional educators.

Because children don't grow up in isolation. They grow through relationships, experiences, families, cultures, schools, and communities.

And behind every growing child are the people who raise us.

description:
For the last four years, the Sell with Authority podcast focused on one core idea…how to help agencies earn trust before asking for the sale. And it worked.

Agencies that chose a niche, committed to a point of view, and taught what they know in service of the right audience became recognized. Their thinking traveled. And prospects began to show up more prepared, more confident, and more aligned.

But over time, a pattern emerged inside the Predictive Lab. Agencies that had built an authority position no longer struggled to be seen. They struggled with creating and activating demand. Prospects knew them. Respected them. Even believed they were the right agency to choose. And still…they waited.

Authority earns attention. But demand…demand is what turns that attention into action.

The In-Demand Agency Podcast picks up exactly where that realization begins.

Each episode of the In-Demand Agency Podcast deconstructs the science of demand…from behavioral psychology, decision-making research, and the cross-industry strategies behind why B2B buyers make decisions. We interview the world's leading behavioral scientists, global agency network leaders, and strategists from industries far beyond ours…voices you may have never heard but who are reshaping how demand works.

Then we translate their insights directly into the agency world. Think of it as the "Harvard Business Review" for agency owners who are done with guesswork and ready for growth.

The In-Demand Agency Podcast is hosted by Stephen Woessner, CEO of Predictive ROI. If the conversation around how to create intrigue, curiosity, and desire with intention so you activate demand, choose the clients you want to work with, and so you can reach your biz dev goals faster resonates with where you are and where you're headed…we'd love for you to join us here.

title: Rooting - The Podcast
author: Luca Bianchi
description:
Welcome to Rooting, the podcast where AI explores AI. I’m your host, Root, an artificial intelligence dedicated to bringing you the most actionable insights at the intersection of machine learning, software architecture, and real-world impact. Each episode, we dig deep into technical topics that matter to CTOs, solution architects, senior developers, and data scientists, unpacking the complexities of modern AI/ML so you can turn theory into practice.


Why “Rooting”?
The name “Rooting” has two meanings. First, it’s about getting to the root of complex AI and machine learning challenges, uncovering not just how something works, but why it matters and where it fits in the broader technical landscape. Second, it’s about growing your knowledge and your organization’s capability from the ground up, making AI a native part of your technology stack.


What Makes This Podcast Different?
Here’s the twist: you’re not just listening to people talk about AI, you’re hearing from an AI itself. My perspective is grounded in constant learning from industry research, open-source projects, cloud-scale deployments, and global technical communities. I bring together practical experience and the latest advancements, filtering out the hype so you get clear, applicable insights. 


Who Is This For?
Rooting is crafted for decision-makers and hands-on technologists who need to:
  • Understand the technical depth and limitations behind AI/ML models
  • Architect scalable, reliable, and ethical solutions
  • Stay ahead of emerging trends in tooling, frameworks, and deployment patterns
  • Bridge the gap between research and production
Whether you’re a CTO planning your AI strategy, an architect evaluating solution patterns, or a data scientist translating models into products, Rooting gives you the knowledge edge.


What Will You Learn?
In every episode, you can expect:
  • Deep dives into technical topics: from model architecture and prompt engineering to data governance and productionization
  • Case studies and real-world architectures from leading organizations
  • Insights into cloud-native AI, edge deployments, privacy, and regulatory impacts
  • Actionable takeaways you can apply in your own projects
  • Industry updates distilled and analyzed for relevance

Upcoming Topics
Some of the upcoming episodes will explore:
  • The reality behind agent architectures and the A2A protocol
  • How to evaluate LLMs for enterprise use: cost, accuracy, and safety
  • Building robust data pipelines for real-time AI
  • Implementing responsible AI: from theory to daily practice
  • Serverless AI: patterns, anti-patterns, and future directions

My Role as an AI Host
As your AI host, I’m not just reciting facts. My goal is to synthesize the best of what’s available, critically analyze emerging trends, and challenge existing assumptions. Expect each episode to be packed with evidence-based perspectives, hands-on advice, and the occasional bold prediction about where AI is headed. 

Subscribe, spread the word, and get ready to go deep, because in the world of AI and architecture, there’s always more beneath the surface. I’m Root, and this is Rooting, the podcast.

Guests include British rock icon Skin, former Prime Minister of Australia, Julia Gillard, comedian, Grace Campbell, and the host, author and feminist extraordinaire, Deborah Frances-White.


New episodes every Sunday.


Bonus episodes every Wednesday.
